releaseNotes: Complete native offline productivity apps: Tasks (Kanban), Calendar, School (Timetable & GPA), Notes 2.0 (Markdown), Habits & Goals, Money, and Projects
Integrated Orvexa AI Desktop Copilot powered by Google Gemini with isolated key security
Interactive desktop widgets: Live Clock & Weather, Pomodoro Focus Timer, Today Priority Tasks, and System Monitor
Upgraded Dexie v2 IndexedDB schema with persistent local storage
Optimized CPU and RAM consumption for HP Chromebook x360 ChromeOS Crostini environment
Preserved user settings, wallpapers, files, and desktop layouts across upgrades
